integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Expressive stylized 3D cartoon animation of a peaceful energetic Brazilian gamers protest, warm afternoon, original adult characters with rounded proportions, matte colored clothes, clear faces and grounded feet. A different male reporter with short brown hair and an orange vest stands left with a plain black microphone. A young adult Black woman with two short hair puffs, purple hoodie and blue jeans stands right with one nearly empty wallet. One uninterrupted wide-medium camera shot, economical sideways physical dolly with depth, faces always large and visible.
Only TWO large rectangular warm-ivory BLANK cardboard placards with thick dark navy rectangular borders exist, held by two background adults entirely above everybody's heads in the upper-left and upper-right corners. Both large clean unmarked interiors face camera, never overlap faces or other objects, stay fully visible and sway very little. No other boards. The crowd's other hands hold no objects. The brick shop facade, windows, clothing and microphone have clean unmarked surfaces. Absolutely no visible lettering in the raw animation; exact text is added by the editor later.
0-3.4s: The reporter turns and asks exactly <d>[Portuguese] E a memória RAM?</d>. The woman listens, raises one eyebrow and opens her nearly empty wallet.
3.4-9.4s: She answers with dry comic frustration, exactly <d>[Portuguese] Pra colocar memória RAM, vou ter que vender a garagem!</d>. One open-hand gesture, wallet remains in her other hand, reporter listens without speaking. The comic stress lands on garagem.
9.4-12.6s: The reporter smiles only after her punchline, nearby protesters laugh briefly and take one grounded step forward, lifting their two blank boards. She looks from her wallet toward the crowd and joins their indignation.
12.6-15.083s: The crowd chants exactly <d>[Portuguese] Mais FPS! Menos boleto!</d>. Finish syllables before14.7s, ongoing gentle board sway and satisfied bodily reaction through the last frame. No additional sentence or frozen tail.
overall_soundscape: Native Brazilian Portuguese speech synchronized to the current speaker. Clear adult male reporter, clear adult female interviewee, quieter crowd during dialogue, then an intelligible final chant. Cardboard rustle, grounded footsteps and soft street ambience. No music or invented background words.
